comment: No source is published for this plugin; everything here comes from the panel art and the VCV library screenshot. All eight drum modules are built the same way: one param 0 to 1, one input, one output, eight lights, samples named KICK_sample1..8 and so on. The knob-shaped control is read as a button (a Schmitt trigger at 1V) that increments a stored index 1 to 8 and wraps. The output is the 16-bit sample scaled by 5.0 divided by the sample's own byte length, so longer samples are quieter; that looks like a mistake by the maker and no voltage is quoted here because of it. The panel prints MiniPoops where the maker's own page names the Korg Minipops.
